## Quality review (docs/quality/review-checklist.md)

- [ ] Code / diagram / explanation stay on the same step
- [ ] Transitions: normal, interrupted, rapid, reduced motion
- [ ] Keyboard + axe (no serious/critical)
- [ ] Error, loading, empty and recovery states
- [ ] No secrets, keys or private data in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Docs updated (README, implementation plan, ADR if a decision changed)
